payload.name: Verify duplicate before SKIP in construction
payload.description: When a construction candidate is marked as a duplicate but no retrieved existing memory matches its subject and content, use this to require verification before SKIP.
content: Before choosing SKIP for a candidate, confirm that an actually retrieved existing memory contains the same subject and fact; never assume duplication from prior conversation or memory. If the existing-memory pool has no matching memory, ADD the candidate as a new memory with the appropriate kind and source link.

solves: Prevents construction from dropping valid extracted facts by SKIPping them as duplicates when no retrieved existing memory actually contains the same information. Applies whenever a candidate is skipped on duplication grounds and the existing-memory pool is empty or lacks a matching memory.
